chapter_seo_title: Dao-Twisted World Ch. 180: Bai Lingmiao Faces a Hungry Corpse on Her Own
chapter_meta_description: Bai Lingmiao takes on her first solo exorcism case. A deceased grandmother returns craving raw meat, and the night is just beginning. Pure Chinese folk horror.
og_title: Chapter 180: The One Who Came Back
og_description: A deceased matriarch returns from her grave and devours an entire cured pork leg. Bai Lingmiao prepares for a night of exorcism in a candlelit funeral hall.
twitter_description: Bai Lingmiao’s solo exorcism begins: a reanimated corpse, a terrified family, and fifty coppers for a night’s work.
